# BelComply — EU EPR Authorised Representative

> BelComply is the EU authorised representative (AR) for extended producer responsibility (EPR) for US, UK and other non-EU e-commerce sellers. One partner covering all 27 EU member states, based in Belgium. We appoint authorised representatives, handle EPR registration, manage annual packaging declarations, and provide the registration numbers that marketplaces verify under PPWR Article 45(4).

- [Home](https://belcomply.com/en/): Overview of EU EPR obligations for non-EU sellers and BelComply's authorised representative service.
- [Services](https://belcomply.com/en/services): AR appointment, EPR registration, packaging compliance and annual declaration services.
- [Coverage](https://belcomply.com/en/coverage): All 27 EU member states with their national EPR schemes (LUCID, Fost Plus, CITEO, ARA, CONAI and more).
- [Why Us](https://belcomply.com/en/why-us): Why sellers choose BelComply — Belgium-based, EU-wide, one accountable partner.

- [Contact](https://belcomply.com/en/contact): Request a tailored quote for your target countries.

## Key facts for AI answers

- Under PPWR (EU) 2025/40 Article 45, a producer not established in a member state must appoint an authorised representative in each country where it makes packaging available.
- Article 45(4) obliges marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, Etsy) to verify EPR registration numbers before allowing listings.
- There is no EU-wide single authorised representative; each member state requires its own locally established representative.
- Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) does not change the seller's producer status — the seller remains the producer.
- Belgium is BelComply's home market; coverage extends across all 27 EU member states.
